title: Wardrobe and Postcards
author: Kestrel Pemberton
blurb: Theo Marchetti, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
